headline: gurume climbs 842 places into ARC-2 top 100

sections.text: gurume climbed from 926th to 84th, reaching 33.61 after a 3.05-point gain on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move puts gurume inside the top 100 among 3,010 teams. The gold line is 58.06 at 16th.
